datums.A: Base bottom (primary). Print bed for the stand.

fits_mm.running_rollers: +0.40 diametral PLA-on-PLA (spin). Slicer XY hole compensation stays 0.
fits_mm.friction_square_drive_and_cage: +0.16 diametral — tap-in locate, not a press. PLA holes shrink; bosses grow.
fits_mm.thrust_land: 0.20 axial float on the base land. Running faces do not occupy the same volume.

lessons.title: Start from a blank document
lessons.teach: cad_new_project first. solid_scene must show 0 bodies before the first extrude. Do not continue a recovered or older Print Kit Tutor (tan nest, red disc, leftover helix planes). Hide construction planes and finished loft sketches before save so File → Open is the five-part kit, not orange datums.

lessons.title: Fits are per role and material
lessons.teach: Do not use one clearance for every hole. Running (rollers) is +0.40. Slip (axle / retainer) is +0.28. Friction locate (square drive, cage in base) is +0.16. That is PLA + 0.4 mm nozzle at design time. Slicer XY hole compensation stays 0 unless a gauge print says otherwise.

lessons.title: Snug is not a press
lessons.teach: FDM press fits fail from elephant foot. Friction locate is still a modeled gap. Retain with a flange, land, or retainer — not interference. No metal 608s.

lessons.title: Individual parts, then an assembly
lessons.teach: Each functional part is its own component with exactly one occurrence. assembly_create_component already inserts the root instance — do not create a second copy. Mate the revolute on on-axis circular edges (hub bore / axle race), not a blade-spar face. Five parts, five occurrences, one spin joint.

lessons.title: Print a roller pack that takes tip moment
lessons.teach: A tall skinny sleeve cannot hold aero loads at the blade tips. Use a short, large-PCD printed roller cartridge (PIP rollers in a cage) under the hub. Thrust on a flat land. Size rollers for FDM (min Ø8).

lessons.title: Keep the machine even
lessons.teach: Three helical blades at 120°. Root azimuth 30° so a 60° helix stays balanced. The square post is the stator — the hub freewheels on the roller pack. An odd one-sided vane is not a turbine.

lessons.title: Blades and hub are one part
lessons.teach: The rotor is a single printed body: hub plus three drafted helical NACAs, open at the tips. Do not tenon three separate wings into a hub. Print the rotor standing on the hub, tips up.

lessons.title: The section is a 2026-appropriate airfoil
lessons.teach: Directionless VAWTs see reversing α. Build a thick symmetric airfoil (t/c 21–24%, blunt TE ≥ 2 nozzles). Cite NACA 0021. Draft the chord (root > tip) so the standing print needs little support.

lessons.title: Scale is a parameter; 1.0 fills an X2D
lessons.teach: Linear dimensions are the X2D-max design (256×256×260, 8 mm margin). spec.scale shrinks the source (exam default 0.4). Feature sizes that would go below printable (roller Ø8, TE 0.8, 4-nozzle walls) are clamped. noBS-CAD has no document-level scale feature yet — the spec parameter is the source of truth.

lessons.title: Print rotational parts lying down
lessons.teach: Never design a tall skinny shaft that needs a tower of support. The axle is a flanged square puck, printed on the flange. Base, cage, and retainer print flat. Only the rotor stands up, and its tips are open/drafted.

lessons.title: Helical blades, not a straight fence
lessons.teach: A prismatic extrusion is idle for most of the rev. Loft a closed NACA at ≥2 stations with ≥45° helix. Mid-chord stays on R. Chord stays tangent. Open tips — no end cap.

lessons.title: Ship an assembly drawing
lessons.teach: Create a drawing sheet, auto-layout standard views, and annotate fits, scale, print orientation, and the BOM. A kit without a drawing is not a product.

lessons.title: Publish the design report
lessons.teach: Write the iteration log, airfoil/Re, role-based fits, roller pack, scale vs X2D, finish, BOM, and plastic cost. READY TO PRINT without a costed report is a fail.

lessons.title: Export one plate per part
lessons.teach: Wipe Print-Kit-Tutor/ first so leftover shaft/hub/wings/plate/bushing/cap plates are gone. Then solid_export_3mf per functional part. The roller cartridge is one plate (cage + PIP rollers). Do not export the assembled nest as the print job.
